item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #VISPRSD
Issued at 04:42 AM 01 October 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Cebu(LapuLapuCity), #Bohol(Tubigon, Calape), #Aklan(Makato, Tangalan and Ibajay) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Cebu(Borbon, Sogod, Catmon, Carmen, Liloan, Consolacion, CityOfCarcar), #NegrosOccidental(SagayCity, CadizCity), #Iloilo(Dumangas, BarotacNuevo), #Aklan(NewWashington, Kalibo, Numancia and Lezo) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
